svg.title: How a release that removes a file of the blueprint reaches the project's own lines
svg.desc: A pull request of the blueprint removes a file of the blueprint. The job update of the Variants workflow fails it until MOVED of blueprint/migrate.py names the file and the one that takes its place. After the release, the update deletes the file, and the step Files of the project finds each line of the project that still names it. A page of Markdown is changed by migrate --fix, which the fix bot commits onto the update. Any other line is a warning and a step of the checklist for you, and a line with blueprint: keep in a comment stays as it is. Then the update merges itself.
